decisive_items: irregular, circumferential thickening of the right third of the transverse colon measuring approximately 8.3 cm
Biopsy of the umbilical lesion demonstrated a well-differentiated, infiltrating adenocarcinoma
response.rationale: R4 is the most specific diagnosis, combining the Sister Mary Joseph nodule with the primary site of metastasis, which is supported by both the umbilical lesion biopsy and the colonic thickening on CT.

rejected.why: Too narrow, only considers the colonic lesion without addressing the umbilical nodule.
Too broad, does not specify the primary site of the cancer or the nature of the umbilical lesion.
Incomplete, does not address the primary site of the metastatic adenocarcinoma.
